item.title: UH Manoa hosting special theater production centered on Lahaina wildfires, rebuilding
item.description: The University of Hawaii at Manoa is debuting a special Hawaii theatre production next month, centered on the Lahaina wildfires and the community's rebuilding. It's written and directed by one of their graduate students and performed in Hawaiian, Pidgin and English.

item.title: Woman, 60s, air lifted out of Lanikai Pillbox Trail
item.description: The Honolulu Fire Department rescued an injured hiker from the Lanikai Pillbox Trail on the morning of Feb. 19.

item.title: Moanalua Freeway repaving project extended by 4 months
item.description: Repaving of the Moanalua Freeway has been extended through July, the Hawaii Department of Transportation announced on Feb. 19.

item.title: OHA Board of Trustees briefed on HPH, HMSA proposed partnership
item.description: The proposed partnership between Hawaii Pacific Health and Hawaii Medical Service Association is currently under federal review.

item.title: Pediatric drowning cases on the rise from last year
item.description: The Honolulu Emergency Medical Services has responded to an alarming rise in near-drowning cases, particularly those involving children.

item.title: 'Grey's Anatomy' star Eric Dane dies after ALS battle
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.

item.title: Kupuna Life: Arcadia's 'Golden Stars'
item.description: More than 100 residents at Arcadia were recently celebrated as "Golden Stars," those who are 90-years-old and up.

item.title: Gaming working group meets with experts from UNLV
item.description: Should we bring gambling to Hawaii? It's a question that raises many more questions. And the working group looking into it is getting some answers from some of the best experts in the world.

item.title: Virus research could turn into 'big win' in Hawaii's beetle battle
item.description: Researchers at the University of Hawaii at Manoa are looking into a type of virus to control and eradicate the coconut rhinoceros beetle, and preliminary findings are promising.

item.title: Union rebukes senator as school leadership bill sparks capitol clash
item.description: HONOLULU (KHON2) -- A bill to restructure Hawaii's public school leadership is drawing strong reaction at the State Capitol. KHON2 obtained a letter from the state's largest public workers union, criticizing a state senator over a tense committee hearing that has sparked a separate dispute over decorum at the hearings.
